[SWS_CORE_10990] MakeErrorCode overload for new error domains
⌈
For all subclasses of ara::core::ErrorDomain, there shall be a constexpr
overload of the global function MakeErrorCode that creates an ara::core::Er-
rorCode instance for a given error condition value within the ara::core::Error-
Domain subclass’s error condition range.
⌋
